mainEntity.name: How do water-wise landscapes impact property value in Southern California?

acceptedAnswer.text: Water-wise landscapes generally enhance property value in Southern California. With ongoing water scarcity and increasing awareness of sustainability, homes with drought-tolerant landscaping are increasingly desirable. They offer lower maintenance costs, reduced water bills, and a more resilient, environmentally responsible outdoor space. Potential buyers often view these features as significant long-term benefits, making such properties more attractive in the competitive real estate market. A well-designed water-wise landscape is an investment that pays dividends.
acceptedAnswer.description: Water-wise landscapes enhance property value in Southern California by offering lower maintenance, reduced water bills, and a more sustainable, desirable outdoor space.
